headline: United States Revises Third-Quarter Growth Upward to 4.3%
summary: The US economy grew at a 4.3% annualized rate in the third quarter, revised sharply up from the 3.4% initial estimate, the Commerce Department reported.
why: GDP measures the total output of the economy and is a key gauge of growth, which shapes expectations for Federal Reserve policy, interest rates and corporate earnings.
why_moved: The Commerce Department revised third-quarter growth up by almost a full percentage point, a materially stronger reading than the initial estimate.
original_headline: Estados Unidos revisa al alza de 4.3% su crecimiento en el tercer trimestre
